items.title: Bill Holman interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 13, 1999
items.q: It must have been around the middle 50s for Peggy Lee. I believe in starting at the top you know.

ctx.x: I have a couple of things that I wanted to play for you. Actually I think it’s a bit early for that, because I wanted to ask about the first time — you had quite a list of singers here that you arranged for also. And when was your first experience doing a chart for a singer?
It must have been around the middle 50s for Peggy Lee. I believe in starting at the top you know.
